listing.title: Udaipur Niketan — Luxury Apartment in the City Centre
listing.description: A beautifully curated apartment nestled in the heart of Udaipur's old city, offering stunning views of the Aravalli hills and Fateh Sagar Lake. This thoughtfully designed space blends heritage charm with modern comforts, perfect for travellers seeking an authentic Rajasthani experience.

host.name: Priya
host.about: Namaste! I'm a passionate host who loves sharing the beauty of Udaipur with travellers from around the world. I'm always available to help with recommendations and local tips.

reviews.author: Arjun
reviews.text: Absolutely stunning place. The views of the lake from the balcony are breathtaking. Priya was an incredible host — so responsive and helpful with local recommendations.

reviews.author: Sophie
reviews.text: One of the best places we've ever stayed. The apartment is beautifully decorated, incredibly clean, and the location couldn't be more central. We'll be back!

reviews.author: Rahul
reviews.text: Perfect for a romantic getaway. The rooftop pool is magical at sunset. Priya left a welcome basket and gave us great tips for exploring Udaipur. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Emma
reviews.text: We loved everything about this apartment. The design is thoughtful and elegant, the beds are incredibly comfortable, and the kitchen is well-stocked. A true home away from home.

reviews.author: Vikram
reviews.text: Great value for the quality. Fast wifi made it perfect for working remotely while exploring Udaipur in the evenings. The host is very attentive.

reviews.author: Isabelle
reviews.text: Beautiful apartment in an amazing location. A few things could be improved but overall a wonderful stay. The view is unbeatable and Priya was very helpful.
